adjudication.rationale: In `app/controllers/admin/embeddable_hosts_controller.rb`, `update` does `host = EmbeddableHost.where(id: params[:id]).first` and then unconditionally calls `save_host(host)`. `save_host` immediately dereferences `host` (`host.host = ...`, `host.category_id = ...`), so if the id is nonexistent and `host` is `nil`, it will raise `NoMethodError`, resulting in a 500.
